title: Lydecker LLP Rolls Out Automated Time Entry Firmwide with PointOne
summary: Lydecker LLP, a Florida-based law firm with offices across multiple markets, is deploying PointOne across the firm, bringing automated time entry to its 98 timekeepers and eliminating the manual reconstruction of the workday.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, September 8th, 2026** — PointOne, the AI revenue platform for law firms, today announced the firmwide deployment of PointOne Time at Lydecker LLP, a Florida-based law firm. The rollout brings automated time entry to the firm's 98 timekeepers, replacing manual entry across one of legal's most persistent operational workflows.


PointOne Time automatically creates time entries as work happens across attorneys' phones, iPads, and laptops, eliminating the need to reconstruct the day from memory. Attorneys, assistants, and billing stakeholders review, refine, and release time within a shared workflow. At Lydecker, PointOne works alongside the firm's existing Clio environment — where timekeepers previously entered time manually — so the firm adopted automated capture without replacing the systems it already runs on.


The firmwide rollout followed a pilot in which Lydecker's attorneys and billing team stress-tested capture accuracy and workflow fit across the firm's practice groups, demonstrating clear operational value for users.


As part of the pilot, PointOne built a dedicated PerfectLaw export for Lydecker, connecting automated time capture directly to the firm's billing environment. The mid-pilot build reflected the pace of the partnership: when Lydecker's workflows called for a capability, PointOne shipped it before the firmwide rollout began.


PointOne is purpose-built for law firms, helping legal teams reduce manual administrative work while maintaining enterprise-grade security, privacy, and control. Beyond timekeeping, PointOne's platform helps firms streamline billing workflows and unlock operational intelligence across the revenue lifecycle.
